title: [@poll error] is not checked unless -enable-poll-insertion is given
summary: `[@poll error]` is not checked unless `-enable-poll-insertion` is given: `let[@poll error] f x = (x, x + 1)` is accepted with no diagnostic. With the flag it is refused, since an allocation is a polling point.

expected.text: `Error: Function with poll-error attribute contains polling points`; exit status 2.
expected.output: Function with poll-error attribute contains polling points

cause: `backend/cfg/cfg_polling.ml`, `instrument_fundecl`: the check is inside the pass that inserts polls, which returns at once when poll insertion is disabled (the default of `configure`).
